title: Foliated Teichmüller theory — Question 11.1
exact_target: Classify nontrivial foliation-preserving mapping classes, including those produced by a transverse flow and invisible to the ordinary ambient mapping class group.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10300047 (AMR-102-0047). CC BY 4.0.
